content.short: Cult of Pigeons is a Cardano NFT art collection with 10,000 illustrated characters and community lore.
content.description: Cult of Pigeons is a Cardano NFT art collection built around 10,000 illustrated characters and a story-driven community identity. The project presents its collection through lore about a secret society, giving holders a shared theme beyond simple profile pictures. It belongs to the Cardano NFT market as a collectible art project where rarity, secondary trading, and community updates drive ongoing interest. Cult of Pigeons focuses on artwork, humor, narrative, and holder participation online today.
